subject: cs
title: Python: Variables, Types & Expressions
summary: The first real programming topic: what a variable is, the core data types, how expressions are evaluated, and how to reason about them — assuming zero prior coding experience.
outcomes: Explain a variable as a name bound to a value, and use assignment correctly
Identify and use the core built-in types: int, float, str, bool
Build and evaluate arithmetic, string, comparison and boolean expressions with correct precedence
Predict a program's output by tracing variable state step by step
Convert between types deliberately and avoid accidental type errors
Read tracebacks well enough to fix a type-related error

CBSE: Cl.11 CS: Python data types & operators
ICSE: Cl.9-10 Computer Applications: variables & data types
IB: DP Computer Science SL: programming fundamentals
